question: A man driving a car at a speed of 48 km/hr crosses a bridge in 4.6 minutes. Find the length of the bridge.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Speed** = 48 km/hr

**Time** = 4.6 minutes = 4.6 ÷ 60 hours

**Length of bridge** = Speed × Time = 48 × (4.6 ÷ 60)

⇒ 0.8 × 4.6 = 3.68 km

**∴ The correct answer is 3.68 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Speed (S)** = 48 km/hr

**Time (T)** = 4.6 minutes

**Formula Used:**

**Distance** = **Speed** × **Time**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee13f54b73896c6632f36958f4e10cb2b87066ef1dc7530c2d129ff1d8e46184.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Convert **time** from minutes to hours: T = 4.6 ÷ 60 hr

⇒ **Length of Bridge** = 48 × (4.6 ÷ 60)

⇒ **Length of Bridge** = (48 ÷ 60) × 4.6

⇒ **Length of Bridge** = 0.8 × 4.6

⇒ **Length of Bridge** = 3.68 km

**∴ The correct answer is 3.68 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. For two equal distances with speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy/(x + y).

Relative Speed

When moving in the same direction, Relative Speed = S₁ − S₂. When moving in opposite directions, Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂.</p
